data.text: started: painter additive tweaks (names/inputEnabled/cursor) + screens/board.ts driver + tests

done — bare hub attention board screen, commit 34fa181 on matchday/tk-avx

WIP resumed and completed. What shipped:
- screens/board.ts: driver wiring boardBody → runBoard. Alt-screen lifecycle (TerminalState enter/restore, idempotent, SIGINT/SIGTERM restore-first), 2s fallback refresh tick, effects → cmd frames through ctx.cmd surface (answer {id,text} / assign {id,task} / attention {action:dismiss,id}); mutations re-list so the item leaves the board next frame (docs/06 answer/assign flows). o/l log overlays reuse render/stream.ts.
- screens/board_state.ts: pure key machine — focus walk items→idle rows with wrap, inline inputs with cursor editing (arrows/backspace/mid-insert), d/a/o/l/q, esc blurs, unknown keys inert. Fully unit-tested without TTY.
- render/board.ts (additive tweaks to merged tk-aum stack, flagged for Coach): names map (display names from list reply), inputsEnabled (piped stdin → inputs hidden + FOOTER_PIPED), mid-cursor block rendering, agent-present from snapshot flag instead of counting kind rows.
- Machine modes: --json/--ndjson one snapshot envelope {orientation, attention, running, idle} exit 0, written through ctx.io.stdout (io.ts contract — was wrongly process.stdout, that was one of the 3 red tests). Pipe stdout → static frame + muted hint, exit 0. Color level via detectColorLevel (NO_COLOR/--no-color/non-TTY → plain).

Fixes to predecessor WIP: (1) emitSnapshot now respects ctx.io; (2) driver assign test walked 2 downs which wraps back to the attention item on a 1-item fixture — needs 3 downs; (3) strict tsc cleanup in both new test files (exactOptionalPropertyTypes, SessionRecord/AttentionItem fixtures).

Acceptance: bun test cli/ 180 pass 0 fail; full workspace 452 pass 0 fail; tsc --noEmit clean. Tests cover board composition (needs-you/running/idle + calm), inline cursor move + type-to-answer → cmd answer, assign flow → cmd assign, dismiss → cmd attention, quiet-key handling, alt-screen enter/exit idempotence, pipe/static-frame + hint exit 0, NO_COLOR via theme tests. Left OPEN for validator.
